name: Reporter
description: a report writer for building re-runnable tabular reports.
project_description:
The Reporter module lets you easily create reports.

It is a Report Writer and turns your SQL into a finished report with its own url.

 It provides a Configuration Editor to name your reports and edit the SQL for the report.

As well a page that lists your reports do you can view them.

 Features 
 Gathers the SQL, Report Name and Report Descriptionor your reports.

 Post-Installation 
 The module comes with some canned example reports.

You go to the config page to delete add or modify reports.
